verdict.rationale: Trello offers automation (trello-docs-3) and a REST API (trello-docs-17, trello-docs-21), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes automation run quotas, API rate limits, or what happens when they are exceeded (overage charges, throttling, or a hard stop). The free-plan blurb and a community complaint about add-on restrictions do not address limit-exceedance behavior.
